title: Prune Messenger messages
description: Deletes the messages of one queue created more than `days` days ago. The queue is required so that a working queue is never emptied by default; usually it is `failed`.

queueName.description: Queue to prune (`queue_name`), e.g. the failure transport's queue

days.description: Keep messages younger than this many days

dryRun.description: Only count the messages that would be deleted
